backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend canister with types for Question, UserProfile, and SubscriptionPlan, plus role-based access-controlled endpoints for managing user profiles, questions, subscription plans, and stored arrays.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented QuizScreen features: a Skip button (REQ-47) and a 60-second countdown timer with auto-skip and red warning at ≤10s (REQ-48).
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of concise per-file summaries for all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, hook, page, and config file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes including background, primary, destructive, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA, setting up PWA manifest, iOS meta tags, theme color, service worker registration, and mounting the root div for the Vite/React app.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for 'AIAPGET Unani PYQ Practice' specifying app name, icons, theme/background colors, display mode, and categories.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first strategy for static assets, network-only for ICP canister/API calls, and network-first with cache fallback for HTML navigation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing screen navigation state across all app screens, conditionally rendering the persistent AppHeader, and wrapping the app in QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Sticky app header with a kebab menu (three-dot) that opens a dropdown navigation drawer linking to all major screens like Home, Topics, History, Subscription, and Admin.
frontend/src/data/questions.ts: Defines the Question interface, topic/year constants, and a static array of Unani medicine multiple-choice questions with explanations used as fallback data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor, using an authenticated identity when available or falling back to anonymous, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching admin questions, adding new questions to the backend, and merging backend questions with static local questions while deduplicating by text.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for storing and retrieving quiz attempt history on the ICP backend, encoding/decoding attempts as packed bigint arrays.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionQuerie: React Query hook that fetches the list of subscription plans from the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines light and dark theme CSS custom properties for a parchment/teal/gold color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelScreen.tsx: Password-protected admin panel that allows authenticated users to add new quiz questions via a form and view existing questions, using React Query mutations and queries against the backend.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryScreen.tsx: Displays the user's past quiz attempts with summary stats (attempts, average score, best score) and a list of individual results, with an option to clear history via the backend actor.
frontend/src/pages/HomeScreen.tsx: Home screen showing a hero banner, stats row, and navigation cards that let users start a random quiz, browse by topic/year, view history, manage subscriptions, or access the admin panel.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentMethodSelector: Payment screen that lets users choose a payment method (UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, wallet), collects relevant details, and simulates a mock payment flow with a success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/QuizScreen.tsx: Interactive quiz screen that presents one question at a time with a 60-second countdown timer, supports answer selection, skip, previous/next navigation, and calls onComplete with results when finished.
frontend/src/pages/ResultsScreen.tsx: Displays quiz results including score percentage, performance tier, correct/incorrect/skipped counts, time taken, and a topic breakdown, while recording the attempt via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/ReviewScreen.tsx: Shows a paginated review of each quiz question with the user's answer highlighted against the correct answer, including correct/incorrect/skipped status badges.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPlansScre: Renders monthly and yearly subscription plan cards with feature lists and a toggle, navigating to the payment screen when the user selects a plan.
frontend/src/pages/TopicBrowserScreen.ts: Allows users to browse and start quizzes filtered by topic or year, fetching all questions from the backend and grouping them into expandable accordion sections.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including from hash-based routes), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state (version 41) for an AIAPGET Unani MCQ practice PWA, including architectural notes, known issues, existing features, and requirements.
